# Task P0-12: Contributor docs, NOTICE and CHANGELOG

**Phase:** 0 · **Depends on:** P0-04 · **Suggested tier:** single-shot API · **Estimated size:** S

## Goal
A newcomer can build, test and contribute without reading the whole planning record, and every piece of ported code is attributed.

## Deliverables (return complete file contents)
- `CONTRIBUTING.md` — prerequisites (.NET SDK 10.0.4xx per `global.json`, Node ≥ 22.12, Docker for the image); build/test commands (backend, frontend, image, `scripts/smoke-test.sh`); repository map (short, pointing at `docs/build/REPO_LAYOUT.md`); coding rules summary pointing at `docs/build/CODING_STANDARDS.md`; Conventional Commits and branch naming; the ported-code rule (header comment + `NOTICE.md` entry; GPL-3.0 sources Lidarr/Prowlarr/Sonarr, MIT SoulSync/spotDL; never copy AGPL code such as Sockseek or slskd); how decisions work (`docs/DECISIONS.md` for product decisions, `docs/adr/` with `0000-template.md` for architecture); "AI-assisted development" paragraph pointing at `docs/build/AGENT_WORKFLOW.md`. Keep it under 120 lines.
- `NOTICE.md` — keep the existing text and add a "Ported code" table (Compilarr file → upstream repository, path, licence) with exactly the entries listed in the input below, plus a "Bundled third-party programs" table: slskd 0.26.0 (AGPL-3.0, unmodified binary, source https://github.com/slskd/slskd/tree/0.26.0), ffmpeg/ffprobe 9.0.2 static builds (GPL, via mwader/static-ffmpeg), Chromaprint fpcalc 1.6.1 (LGPL-2.1+ / MIT components), Deno 2.9.7 (MIT), s6-overlay 3.2.3.2 (ISC).
- `CHANGELOG.md` — Keep a Changelog format; an `Unreleased` section and a `0.0.1-alpha.1` section summarising Phase 0 (skeleton, config, SQLite, auth + URL base, status/health, logging with redaction, command queue + scheduler, SignalR, UI shell, bundled slskd supervisor, Docker image, CI).
- `README.md` — add links to `CONTRIBUTING.md`, `NOTICE.md`, `CHANGELOG.md` and a "Quick start (Docker)" block using `docker/docker-compose.yml`; leave everything else unchanged.

## Allowed paths
- `CONTRIBUTING.md`, `NOTICE.md`, `CHANGELOG.md`, `README.md`

## Input
The orchestrator appends the current `NOTICE.md`, `README.md`, `CHANGELOG.md`, `CONTRIBUTING.md` and the list of ported files when running this task.

## Acceptance criteria
1. Every ported file named in the input appears in `NOTICE.md` with its upstream path and licence.
2. The commands in `CONTRIBUTING.md` are the ones in `CLAUDE.md` "Commands" (plus the smoke test) — no invented scripts.
3. Markdown only; no HTML beyond what the files already use.

## Done-report
Use the format in `docs/build/WORKER_SYSTEM_PROMPT.md`.
